{"id":"de-minimum-wage-2026","officialId":"MiLoV5","title":"最低工资分两步升至 €14.60","originalTitle":"Fünfte Mindestlohnanpassungsverordnung","region":"DE","topic":"工作与收入","tags":["工作","工资"],"phase":"adopted","status":"分步生效","summary":"2026年最低时薪为13.90欧元；下一次已确定的上调在2027年1月。","before":"2025年最低时薪为12.82欧元。","after":"2026年1月1日起13.90欧元；2027年1月1日起14.60欧元，均为税前每小时。","impact":"适用法定最低工资的雇员和雇主。","limits":"行业最低工资可能更高。此处跟踪法定调整，不把名义工资上调直接等同于实际购买力上升。","verifiedAt":"2026-10-02","lastEventDate":"2026-01-01","effectiveDate":"2026-01-01","nextDate":"2027-01-01","nextLabel":"第二步：最低时薪升至 €14.60","disputed":false,"dispute":"","sources":[{"id":"wage-bmas","title":"第五次最低工资调整条例","url":"https://www.bmas.de/DE/Service/Gesetze-und-Gesetzesvorhaben/fuenfte-mindestlohnanpassungsverordnung-milov5.html","publisher":"BMAS","kind":"government","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"},{"id":"wage-law","title":"MiLoV5 法律全文","url":"https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/milov5/","publisher":"Gesetze im Internet","kind":"law","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"}],"rules":[{"title":"2026年每工作一小时，税前至少13.90欧元","detail":"适用法定最低工资的雇员，按实际工作时间计算税前下限；不是到手收入。","sourceId":"wage-law"},{"title":"2027年再升到14.60欧元","detail":"第二步已确定，不是仍待表决的承诺。行业或合同约定高于这个标准的，不能据此降薪。","sourceId":"wage-law"}],"dateExplanation":"2026年1月1日既是本条例开始生效日，也是13.90欧元档的开始日。14.60欧元档已写入条例，从2027年1月1日开始。","events":[{"id":"proposal","date":"2025-06-27","kind":"proposal","title":"最低工资委员会提出建议","detail":"委员会提出两阶段调整建议，后被联邦政府以条例落实。","sourceId":"wage-bmas"},{"id":"first","date":"2026-01-01","kind":"effective","title":"第一阶段实施","detail":"最低时薪调整为13.90欧元。","sourceId":"wage-law"},{"id":"second","date":"2027-01-01","kind":"scheduled","title":"第二阶段实施","detail":"条例确定最低时薪上调为14.60欧元。","sourceId":"wage-bmas"}]}

{"id":"de-crypto-reporting-dac8","officialId":"DIP 324801 / KStTG","title":"加密平台要向税务部门报告用户身份和交易信息","originalTitle":"Kryptowerte-Steuertransparenz-Gesetz 分步实施","summary":"符合条件的加密平台需收集用户税务居民身份、税号及交易汇总，向德国联邦中央税务局申报。义务首次覆盖2026年，通常在次年7月31日前申报；这不等于取消个人持币一年的税务待遇。","before":"原有金融账户信息交换制度不能完整覆盖加密资产交易。","after":"平台按法律收集和核实用户税务信息，并按年报告交易汇总，供国内征税及符合条件的跨国信息交换使用。","impact":"加密资产服务商及属于该制度申报范围的用户。","limits":"并非每个钱包、每类资产或每位用户都一律被申报，需符合该法适用范围。它改变信息收集与申报，不直接决定某笔收益应纳多少税，也不取消持有期规则。既有用户身份核实存在过渡期限。","verifiedAt":"2026-10-02","lastEventDate":"2026-01-01","effectiveDate":"2025-12-24","nextDate":"2027-01-01","nextLabel":"既有用户身份核实过渡期限","disputed":false,"dispute":"","sources":[{"id":"crypto-law","title":"KStTG：加密资产税务信息申报法","url":"https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ksttg/","publisher":"Gesetze revisions.data: {"id":"de-rent-cap-2029","officialId":"BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 163","title":"租金刹车延长至 2029 年","originalTitle":"Verlängerung der Mietpreisbremse","region":"DE","topic":"住房","phase":"adopted","status":"已生效","summary":"联邦延长了各州指定租赁市场紧张地区的法律依据；具体哪些城市适用，仍由州条例确定。","before":"相关授权原定于2025年底结束。","after":"延长至2029年底。指定地区新租约原则上不得超过当地可比租金的110%，仍有法定例外。","impact":"在被指定地区寻找出租住房的人，以及出租人。","limits":"不是全国所有住宅统一限价。新建、全面现代化后的首次出租及既有租金等例外需要按具体情况核对。","verifiedAt":"2026-10-02","lastEventDate":"2025-07-23","effectiveDate":"2025-07-23","nextDate":null,"nextLabel":"继续关注各州的适用区域与期限","disputed":false,"dispute":"","sources":[{"id":"rent-federal","title":"联邦政府：租金刹车延长至2029年","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/verlaengerung-mietpreisbremse-2350648","publisher":"Bundesregierung","kind":"government","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"}],"events":[{"id":"law-date","date":"2025-07-17","kind":"adopted","title":"法律签署","detail":"法律日期：2025年7月17日，BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 163。","sourceId":"rent-federal"},{"id":"in-force","date":"2025-07-23","kind":"effective","title":"延长法生效","detail":"联邦政府确认该法于7月23日生效。","sourceId":"rent-federal"}]}

{"id":"de-minimum-wage-2026","officialId":"MiLoV5","title":"最低工资分两步升至 €14.60","originalTitle":"Fünfte Mindestlohnanpassungsverordnung","region":"DE","topic":"工作与收入","phase":"adopted","status":"分步生效","summary":"2026年最低时薪为13.90欧元；下一次已确定的上调在2027年1月。","before":"2025年最低时薪为12.82欧元。","after":"2026年1月1日起13.90欧元；2027年1月1日起14.60欧元，均为税前每小时。","impact":"适用法定最低工资的雇员和雇主。","limits":"行业最低工资可能更高。此处跟踪法定调整，不把名义工资上调直接等同于实际购买力上升。","verifiedAt":"2026-10-02","lastEventDate":"2026-01-01","effectiveDate":"2026-01-01","nextDate":"2027-01-01","nextLabel":"第二步：最低时薪升至 €14.60","disputed":false,"dispute":"","sources":[{"id":"wage-bmas","title":"第五次最低工资调整条例","url":"https://www.bmas.de/DE/Service/Gesetze-und-Gesetzesvorhaben/fuenfte-mindestlohnanpassungsverordnung-milov5.html","publisher":"BMAS","kind":"government","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"},{"id":"wage-law","title":"MiLoV5 法律全文","url":"https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/milov5/","publisher":"Gesetze im Internet","kind":"law","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"}],"events":[{"id":"proposal","date":"2025-06-27","kind":"proposal","title":"最低工资委员会提出建议","detail":"委员会提出两阶段调整建议，后被联邦政府以条例落实。","sourceId":"wage-bmas"},{"id":"first","date":"2026-01-01","kind":"effective","title":"第一阶段实施","detail":"最低时薪调整为13.90欧元。","sourceId":"wage-law"},{"id":"second","date":"2027-01-01","kind":"scheduled","title":"第二阶段实施","detail":"条例确定最低时薪上调为14.60欧元。","sourceId":"wage-bmas"}]}

{"id":"de-crypto-reporting-dac8","officialId":"DIP 324801 / KStTG","title":"加密资产服务商开始承担税务申报义务","originalTitle":"Kryptowerte-Steuertransparenz-Gesetz (DAC8)","region":"DE","topic":"税务与加密资产","phase":"adopted","status":"已通过 · 开始实施","summary":"德国落实DAC8的信息收集、申报及跨境交换框架，重点是加密资产服务商的税务透明度义务。","before":"原有金融账户信息交换制度不能完整覆盖加密资产交易。","after":"为加密服务商建立专门的尽职调查与申报制度；具体期限以KStTG相关条款为准。","impact":"加密资产服务商及属于该制度申报范围的用户。","limits":"这是信息申报制度，不能据此推断个人持币一年的税务待遇已经取消。首次申报期限和不同过渡安排需逐条核实。","verifiedAt":"2026-10-02","lastEventDate":"2025-12-22","effectiveDate":null,"nextDate":null,"nextLabel":"继续核实首个申报周期与执行细则","disputed":false,"dispute":"","sources":[{"id":"crypto-law","title":"KStTG：加密资产税务信息申报法","url":"https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ksttg/","publisher":"Gesetze im Internet","kind":"law","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"},{"id":"crypto-dip","title":"DAC8 立法过程：DIP 324801","url":"https://dip.bundestag.de/vorgang/-/324801","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","kind":"parliament","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"}],"events":[{"id":"bundestag","date":"2025-11-06","kind":"adopted","title":"联邦议院完成二、三读","detail":"DIP记录2025年11月6日的二、三读。","sourceId":"crypto-dip"},{"id":"bundesrat","date":"2025-12-19","kind":"adopted","title":"联邦参议院第二轮处理","detail":"DIP记录12月19日第二轮处理。","sourceId":"crypto-dip"},{"id":"law","date":"2025-12-22","kind":"adopted","title":"法律形成","detail":"DIP记录法律日期为2025年12月22日。","sourceId":"crypto-dip"}]}

Hessen 2025 Nr. 74","title":"黑森现行租客保护延长至 2026 年11月","originalTitle":"Verordnung zur Änderung der Mieterschutzverordnung","region":"DE-HE","topic":"住房","phase":"adopted","status":"已生效","summary":"黑森延长了现行租客保护条例，保留原有适用地区，等待新一轮市场评估和条例修订。","before":"现行条例原计划于2025年到期。","after":"现行条例延长至2026年11月25日。覆盖地区仍按现行条例确定。","impact":"黑森条例指定地区的租客和出租人。","limits":"不能把拟议中的71个市镇名单当成已经生效的范围。现行和拟议条例分别记录。","verifiedAt":"2026-10-02","lastEventDate":"2025-11-18","effectiveDate":"2025-11-18","nextDate":"2026-11-25","nextLabel":"现行条例到期；需核实是否已有接续条例","disputed":false,"dispute":"","sources":[{"id":"he-law","title":"黑森法律公报：2025年第74号","url":"https://verkuendung.hessen.de/sites/verkuendung.hessen.de/files/veroeffentlichungsplattform_plugin/published/1174/GVBl_2025_Nr_74_Regelungstext.pdf","publisher":"Hessische Landesregierung","kind":"law","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"},{"id":"he-info","title":"黑森住房部门：现行条例与拟议修订","url":"https://wirtschaft.hessen.de/wohnen-und-bauen/wohnungsrecht/mieterschutzverordnung","publisher":"Hessen Wirtschaft","kind":"government","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"}],"events":[{"id":"signed","date":"2025-11-12","kind":"adopted","title":"州政府制定修订条例","detail":"延长现行条例的有效期。","sourceId":"he-law"},{"id":"published","date":"2025-11-17","kind":"published","title":"法律公报公布","detail":"2025年第74号法律公报。","sourceId":"he-law"},{"id":"effective","date":"2025-11-18","kind":"effective","title":"公布次日生效","detail":"第2条规定公布次日生效。","sourceId":"he-law"},{"id":"expiry","date":"2026-11-25","kind":"scheduled","title":"现行期限结束","detail":"新条例尚需独立核实，不能默认自动续期。","sourceId":"he-info"}]}

{"id":"by-rent-protection-2026","officialId":"MiSchuV Bayern / Neufassung 2025-12-16","title":"巴伐利亚租金保护扩至 285 个市镇","originalTitle":"Neufassung der Mieterschutzverordnung","region":"DE-BY","topic":"住房","phase":"adopted","status":"已生效","summary":"新条例从2026年1月开始适用，扩大了州内被认定为租赁市场紧张的地区。","before":"此前覆盖208个市镇。","after":"扩大到285个市镇，主要增加慕尼黑周边及上巴伐利亚南部地区。","impact":"新增覆盖地区及原覆盖地区中符合规定的租赁关系。","limits":"市镇名单和具体租赁例外应核对条例；增加覆盖地区不等于已经证明租金下降。","verifiedAt":"2026-10-02","lastEventDate":"2026-01-01","effectiveDate":"2026-01-01","nextDate":null,"nextLabel":"关注条例后续调整与适用地区","disputed":false,"dispute":"","sources":[{"id":"by-government","title":"巴伐利亚：2026年起覆盖285个市镇","url":"https://www.bayern.de/neufassung-der-mieterschutzverordnung-mietpreisbremse-gilt-ab-januar-2026-in-285-staedten-und-gemeinden-ausweitung-vor-allem-im-grossraum-muenchen-und-im-oberland-justizminister-eisenreich-me/","publisher":"Bayerische Staatsregierung","kind":"government","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"}],"events":[{"id":"adopted","date":"2025-12-16","kind":"adopted","title":"州政府通过新版条例","detail":"官方公布新条例及覆盖范围。","sourceId":"by-government"},{"id":"effective","date":"2026-01-01","kind":"effective","title":"新条例生效","detail":"覆盖市镇数量从208增至285。","sourceId":"by-government"}]}

{"id":"de-fuel-relief-2026","officialId":"Spritpreis-Entlastungspaket / 2026-10","title":"汽柴油能源税临时下调至年底","originalTitle":"Steuersenkung für Diesel und Benzin bis Jahresende","region":"DE","topic":"税务与加密资产","phase":"adopted","status":"已生效 · 临时措施","summary":"联邦政府确认：2026年10月1日至年底，汽柴油能源税每升下调14欧分。","before":"此前没有本轮临时每升14欧分的能源税减让。","after":"能源税每升减少14欧分，计入相应增值税影响后税收减让约为17欧分。","impact":"购买汽柴油的个人与企业。","limits":"税额变化不等同于加油站售价必然等额下降。当前依据政府正式实施说明，尚未补齐法律公报编号。","verifiedAt":"2026-10-02","lastEventDate":"2026-10-01","effectiveDate":"2026-10-01","nextDate":"2026-12-31","nextLabel":"临时减税期限结束","disputed":false,"dispute":"","sources":[{"id":"fuel-government","title":"联邦政府：汽柴油临时减税","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/entlastung-spritpreise-2453192","publisher":"Bundesregierung","kind":"government","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"}],"events":[{"id":"effective","date":"2026-10-01","kind":"effective","title":"减税开始实施","detail":"政府说明起止期间为10月1日至2026年底。","sourceId":"fuel-government"},{"id":"end","date":"2026-12-31","kind":"scheduled","title":"临时措施到期","detail":"继续检查是否延期，不自动推定延期。","sourceId":"fuel-government"}]}

{"id":"he-rent-protection-proposal-2026","officialId":"Hessen MiSchuV Neufassung / Entwurf 2026","title":"黑森拟将租客保护扩至 71 个市镇","originalTitle":"Geplante Neufassung der Mieterschutzverordnung","region":"DE-HE","topic":"住房","phase":"pending","status":"拟议修订","summary":"州政府拟扩大保护范围，同时调整转换为产权住房后的解约保护期限；尚需州内阁通过。","before":"当前适用既有条例；部分情形的延长解约保护期限为8年。","after":"拟覆盖71个市镇，租金刹车拟延长3年，其他保护规定拟定5年；延长解约保护期拟由8年改为6年。","impact":"拟新增覆盖地区的租客，以及涉及住房产权转换的租赁关系。","limits":"官方预计2026年11月中旬提交内阁；这是预期时间，不是已经通过。不同变动对不同租客的影响可能不同。","verifiedAt":"2026-10-02","lastEventDate":"2026-10-02","effectiveDate":null,"nextDate":null,"nextLabel":"官方预计11月中旬内阁审议，具体日期未确认","disputed":false,"dispute":"","sources":[{"id":"he-info","title":"黑森住房部门：现行条例与拟议修订","url":"https://wirtschaft.hessen.de/wohnen-und-bauen/wohnungsrecht/mieterschutzverordnung","publisher":"Hessen Wirtschaft","kind":"government","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"}],"events":[{"id":"proposal-verified","date":"2026-10-02","kind":"proposal","title":"核实官方拟议修订说明","detail":"核实日：官方称8月已开展市镇前期参与，预计11月中旬由内阁通过。具体会议日期未确认。","sourceId":"he-info"}]}

{"id":"de-crypto-holding-proposal","officialId":"BT-Drs. 21/5752","title":"取消加密资产持有期优惠的议案","originalTitle":"Gesetzentwurf für höhere Besteuerung von Kryptowerten","region":"DE","topic":"税务与加密资产","phase":"pending","status":"议案已提出 · 后续待核实","summary":"绿党议案主张对私人出售加密资产的所得，不论持有时间长短，适用个人所得税税率。","before":"个人私人交易的税务处理与持有期限有关；具体适用需按现行法核对。","after":"该议案拟取消持有期因素；目前收录材料只证明议案已提出。","impact":"以私人财产持有和出售加密资产的人。","limits":"不等于现行规则已修改，也不与政府的其他税改设想合并。已查到的官方记录截至5月6日，后续办理状态仍需补证。","verifiedAt":"2026-10-02","lastEventDate":"2026-05-06","effectiveDate":null,"nextDate":null,"nextLabel":"核实21/5752的后续审议与表决记录","disputed":false,"dispute":"","sources":[{"id":"crypto-proposal","title":"联邦议院：绿党加密资产税收法案","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1174328","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","kind":"parliament","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"}],"events":[{"id":"introduced","date":"2026-05-06","kind":"proposal","title":"联邦议院发布议案说明","detail":"议案编号21/5752；现有证据不支持标为已通过。","sourceId":"crypto-proposal"}]}

{"id":"de-carf-agreement-2026","officialId":"BT-Drs. 21/7195","title":"加密资产国际信息交换协定待表决","originalTitle":"Mehrseitige Vereinbarung über den automatischen Austausch von Informationen nach dem Melderahmen für Kryptowerte","region":"DE","topic":"税务与加密资产","phase":"pending","status":"已排入表决议程","summary":"联邦议院公布了10月8日的表决安排，涉及2023年多边加密资产信息交换协定。","before":"德国已于2024年签署协定；签署不等于此次国内立法程序已经完成。","after":"拟通过法律落实该多边协定的国内批准程序，促进相关税务信息跨境交换。","impact":"加密资产信息申报及国际税务合作涉及的机构和用户。","limits":"议程可能调整；10月8日尚未到来，不能预先记录通过或否决。此事项与DAC8和持有期税改分开。","verifiedAt":"2026-10-02","lastEventDate":"2026-09-28","effectiveDate":null,"nextDate":"2026-10-08","nextLabel":"联邦议院计划表决","disputed":false,"dispute":"","sources":[{"id":"carf-parliament","title":"联邦议院：10月8日拟表决加密信息交换协定法案","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2026/kw41-de-kryptowerte-1217548","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","kind":"parliament","note":"支持页面中的政策事实；以原文适用范围为准。"}],"events":[{"id":"bill","date":"2026-07-16","kind":"proposal","title":"政府法案文件","detail":"法案编号21/7195。","sourceId":"carf-parliament"},{"id":"agenda","date":"2026-09-28","kind":"proposal","title":"公布表决安排","detail":"议会预告10月8日审议表决。","sourceId":"carf-parliament"},{"id":"vote","date":"2026-10-08","kind":"scheduled","title":"计划表决","detail":"表决结果尚未发生，届时回查官方记录。","sourceId":"carf-parliament"}]}

settings.value: 德国周更：尝试58个登记渠道及现有政策来源，新增6项中文解释和8条原文记录；已核读不来梅港广告印刷品规定及联邦第283至285号公报。黑森医院项目分配仍为初步方案；两项加密议案仍待10月8日表决，黑森租客保护仍为拟议修订。仅不来梅公报10月2日至3日区间查全；其余渠道保留部分或受阻状态，七日回查未穷尽。本轮未复核法国、荷兰、瑞士；新增解释及原文记录的德英译文已补齐；翻译补全未推进事实复核日期或扩大来源覆盖。
每周日08:30（德国时间）复核；当前定时指令范围为德国联邦与16州
本次仅新增法国：复核电子发票官方说明，登记两项待核实法令。法国地方层级未接入，国家级来源未查全；德国记录和复核日期未改变。
法国全国层面及18个大区范围已接入，新增13项地方解读和5条待核实记录。地方入口已逐一尝试读取，未形成连续查全日期；省、市镇及其他特殊海外属地尚未接入。
荷兰专项复核：更正弗莱福兰、乌得勒支和北荷兰的时间线，恢复6条公告原文标题。沿用原始官方证据；未扩大扫描覆盖，全部渠道仍为部分检查或受阻。
瑞士定向复核：纠正4个未加载目录入口的成功标记和施维茨法律汇编地址，补齐伯尔尼及苏黎世已确定日期的提醒。施维茨新入口下载返回HTTP 403；旧存档与历史扫描保留。28项解释及8条公告未扩增，全部82个渠道仍未连续查全，市镇未独立接入。

德国周更：尝试58个登记渠道及现有政策来源，新增6项中文解释和8条原文记录；已核读不来梅港广告印刷品规定及联邦第283至285号公报。黑森医院项目分配仍为初步方案；两项加密议案仍待10月8日表决，黑森租客保护仍为拟议修订。仅不来梅公报10月2日至3日区间查全；其余渠道保留部分或受阻状态，七日回查未穷尽。本轮未复核法国、荷兰、瑞士；新增解释及原文记录的德英译文已补齐；翻译补全未推进事实复核日期或扩大来源覆盖。
意大利首批内容补录：现有24项解读，其中全国4项、20个大区各1项；新增23项及官方原文。涵盖税收、家庭、住房、照护、经营、教育、环境等，不是意大利全部政策。均为历史补录，未推进2026年10月2日起的完整监测覆盖。西西里补助资料存在差异；部分公报或附件访问失败，已保留问题。两个自治省及大区议会、地方公报仍未作为独立渠道完整接入。
欧盟首批历史补录：漫游、欧元即时转账和通用充电接口3项解读。已归档欧盟委员会、欧洲央行及德国联邦网络局说明，并核对漫游的生效与到期日期；EUR-Lex 法律原文尚未归档。未完成2026-10-02起逐日扫描，也未逐国核查指令转化；不代表欧盟全部法规。
